questions.stem: What is the name of the ester formed when ethanol reacts with ethanoic acid?
questions.explanation: When naming esters, the first part comes from the alcohol (ethanol -> ethyl) and the second part from the acid (ethanoic acid -> ethanoate). So the ester is ethyl ethanoate. The equation is: CH3COOH + C2H5OH <=> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O.
